name: Ruhr industrial electrician seeking direct permanent employment

context.geography: Ruhr region; practical local commute required
context.employment_state: Working on a temporary agency contract
constraints: Accepts shift work including nights if rota and supplements are clear
Contract must not merely offer a possible future takeover
context.company_awareness: Some local manufacturers known; seeks additional identifiable plants

trigger: Another agency extension prompts a search for a permanent plant role with transparent shift terms.

searches_run.query: Elektroniker Betriebstechnik Ruhrgebiet unbefristet Hersteller Stellen
searches_run.observation: Retrieval mixed regional boards, direct businesses and agency assignments with takeover possibilities. A BA direct-placement result explicitly distinguished employment by the manufacturer from agency work.

searches_run.query: Betriebselektriker Ruhrgebiet Direktanstellung Schichtzulagen Schichtsystem Hersteller
searches_run.observation: Results included staffing listings and a manufacturer PDF. Direct inspection of that PDF specifies a continuous six-shift system, 38-hour week and tariff-based supplements, but the plant is Erwitte, outside the core Ruhr area, and exact supplement rates are absent.

sources.title: Betriebselektriker Direktvermittlung Ruhrgebiet — BA / DIS AG
sources.supports: Retrieved direct-placement advertisement states direct employer employment and a regulated shift model; actual manufacturer identity and rota are not resolved.

sources.title: Elektroniker Betriebstechnik — DIS AG
sources.supports: Retrieved result explicitly uses agency employment with takeover prospects, a different relationship from immediate direct employment.

sources.title: Elektriker Betriebstechnik Schichtsystem — Wittekind/Miebach
sources.supports: Direct employer PDF identifies the manufacturer and Erwitte site, continuous six-shift system, 38-hour week and tariff-based supplements. It does not state exact supplement amounts or prove permanent contract terms.

best_entry_page.promise: Help compare industrial roles by actual employer, plant, contract wording, shift model and stated supplements without assuming shifts are undesirable.
proof_needed: Verified manufacturer coverage and plant locations
Distinguish direct placement from agency employment and takeover options
Permanent contract evidence separate from direct employment
Rota detail and actual supplement wording with unknowns retained
No net-pay or legal entitlement calculation
New indexable guide; current company/search pages are noindex

conversion_objections: Is the employer the manufacturer or an agency?
Which exact plant would I commute to?
Does unbefristet describe an agency contract?
What does the rotation actually look like?
Are supplements quantified or just advertised as attractive?

avoid_targeting.reason: This persona accepts nights; exclusion would discard suitable roles.
Future employer decisions cannot be guaranteed.
Financial/tax calculation is outside product scope.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Schichtarbeit ist für mich in Ordnung, wenn ich den Plan und die Vergütung nachvollziehen kann. Entscheidend sind der echte Arbeitgeber, ein unbefristeter Vertrag und ein Werk, das ich vernünftig erreiche.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic scenario with two separate queries and one direct employer PDF inspection. Remaining queries are hypotheses. No individual commute, pay entitlement, contract or availability verified. Manufacturer example is outside the core target geography and is evidence of useful detail, not a recommended vacancy. Coverage and direct-employer filtering remain unproven.
